title: The five non-negotiable skills, reposted
oneliner: A repost of his non-negotiable skills reel from December 2025 - same message: know your cloud's AI services, your project's LLMs, and containerization.
says: Same script as the December 2025 skills reel: know the AI services on your cloud of choice (watsonx for IBM Cloud, SageMaker and Bedrock for AWS), know the LLMs your project will use (Granite, AWS's models, open-source models on Hugging Face), and know containerization.
explained: The content is a repeat of reel #11, so the explanation lives there. The interesting part is that he reposted it five months later - a signal he considers this the baseline checklist his audience keeps needing.

If you already worked through #11, treat this as revision: the stack-specific skills audit - my cloud's AI services, my project's models, my container platform - is worth redoing whenever your stack changes.
takeaway: Duplicate of #11 - same five non-negotiables. Use it as a prompt to re-audit yourself against your current stack.
